newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Kaifood says vendors plan increased stake.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Kaifood says vendors plan increased stake.

text.p: South Africa's Kairinos Foods Ltd (Kaifood), which lists on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) later this month, said on Wednesday certain vendors were arranging bridging finance to enable them to acquire 23 million shares in the company.

A company notice said Kaifood's promoters were entering into agreements with strategic investors and this would reduce the promoters' shareholding to about 53 million shares, or 20 percent of the company's issued share capital, instead of the 86 million shares (33 percent) set out in the prospectus.

The company said that in the event of profit warranties being exceeded by certain of the vendors, an additional payment at a price of 100 cents per share, computed on the basis of six times the after-tax excess earnings, will be made to them.
In the event that profit warranties were not met by certain vendors, the additional payment to these vendors would be reduced or extinguished.
The firm's listing is due to go ahead on July 22 and the offer closes on July 15.
